an4.191:2.17: statements, mixed prose & verse, discussions, verses, inspired exclamations, legends, stories of past lives, amazing stories, and elaborations.
an4.191:2.18: They’ve followed those teachings by ear, consolidated them by voice, examined them by the mind, and well penetrated them theoretically.
an4.191:2.20: Though they’re happy there, passages of the teaching don’t come back to them.
an4.191:2.21: However, a mendicant with psychic powers, who has achieved mastery of the mind, teaches Dhamma to the assembly of gods.
an4.191:2.23: ‘I used to lead the spiritual life in this same teaching and training.’
an4.191:3.17: statements, mixed prose & verse, discussions, verses, inspired exclamations, legends, stories of past lives, amazing stories, and elaborations.
an4.191:3.18: They’ve followed those teachings by ear, consolidated them by voice, examined them by the mind, and well penetrated them theoretically.
an4.191:3.20: But passages of the teaching don’t come back to them when they’re happy, nor does a mendicant with psychic powers, who has achieved mastery of the mind, teach Dhamma to the assembly of gods.
an4.191:3.21: However, a godling teaches Dhamma to the assembly of gods.
an4.191:3.23: ‘I used to lead the spiritual life in this same teaching and training.’
an4.191:4.19: statements, mixed prose & verse, discussions, verses, inspired exclamations, legends, stories of past lives, amazing stories, and elaborations.
an4.191:4.20: They’ve followed those teachings by ear, consolidated them by voice, examined them by the mind, and well penetrated them theoretically.
an4.191:4.22: But passages of the teaching don’t come back to them when they’re happy, and neither a mendicant with psychic powers, who has achieved mastery of the mind, nor a godling teaches Dhamma to the assembly of gods.
an4.191:4.23: But a being who has been reborn spontaneously reminds another such being:
an4.191:4.24: ‘Do you remember, good fellow? Do you remember where we used to lead the spiritual life?’
